instruction: In this directory, write a report from the files in logs/ (only files ending in .log). A log line looks like `<timestamp> <LEVEL> <message>`; ignore lines that do not match. Create report/summary.txt with one line per level, `<LEVEL> <count>`, sorted by count descending and then by level name ascending. Create report/errors.txt with the message of every ERROR line, in order of file name and then line order. Both files end with a newline. Do not modify logs/.
